movers.headline: revises its **preferential issue up Rs 21 crore to Rs 141.00 crore** for a list running from **Kiran Vyapar and Singularity Large Value Fund III to Utpal Sheth**, pending members' approval
wins, with LC Infra, two **Swachh Maharashtra sewage-treatment EPC orders for Pune and Nagpur worth Rs 740.06 crore including GST**, of which **Krystal's 40% share is Rs 296.02 crore** over two years
movers.quantum: Rs 296.02 cr, Krystal's share; ~35.2% of mcap

movers.headline: signs a **binding framework agreement for CPP Investment Board to invest up to Rs 3,000 crore in wholly-owned Prestige Hospitality Ventures for up to 28%**, subject to definitive documents
movers.quantum: up to Rs 3,000 cr; ~4.4% of mcap

movers.headline: agrees to sell **Mekhali Power Transmission and DBL Renewable to Alpha Alternatives**. The **~Rs 8,400 crore is combined project cost**; the consideration is a phased mechanism and the definitive agreements are unsigned
movers.quantum: ~Rs 8,400 cr of PROJECT COST, not a price

movers.headline: gives **in-principle approval to a ~Rs 800 crore two-phase Haldia expansion** into cold-rolled and coated steel, timelines contingent on a West Bengal incentive request
its US subsidiary executes a **statement of work with SpaceX International Ltd, MY, worth a minimum USD 150,000,000 over 18 months** across AI infrastructure, cybersecurity, telecom and data centres
movers.quantum: USD 150 mn minimum; no rupee figure in the filing

movers.headline: is **successful bidder for two WBSEDCL battery-storage projects at Jeerat and Kharagpur, 100 MW / 400 MWh, about Rs 400 crore**, on a 15-year build-own-operate basis
wins **Rs 295 crore including GST from the Ministry of Defence** for simulators, executable within a year - the day's largest defence order
movers.quantum: Rs 295 cr incl GST; ~1.9% of mcap

movers.headline: clarifies the objects of a **proposed Rs 218.35 crore convertible-warrant issue** - Rs 185.60 crore for expansion and Rs 32.75 crore general corporate - pending its extraordinary general meeting
receives an IOCL **biodiesel allocation of Rs 173.45 crore across IOCL, BPCL and HPCL over 92 days**, of which about Rs 15.41 crore was already published on 05-Aug

business_updates: **Results season is the shape of the day** - **399 results filings and 116 transcripts** among 831 material rows; their rupee figures are revenue and margin, not deals.

**CMS Info Systems** - reports **about Rs 500 crore of new order wins in the quarter**, led by an HDFC Bank managed-services mandate and two PSU-bank recycler mandates _(~11.1% of mcap; a quarterly inflow, not one award)_.

**Order books restated in results releases, all cumulative:** **KEC** (over Rs 40,000 crore including L1), **Astra Microwave** (Rs 2,849 crore), **HPL Electric** (over Rs 3,200 crore), **Triveni Turbine** and **Dilip Buildcon** (Rs 27,691 crore).
**ITI Limited** - collaborates with **Airtel Business** on data centres, cybersecurity and IoT, with **no commercial terms disclosed**.
capex_core: **Lumax Auto Technologies** - **~Rs 156.23 crore** for an Intelligent Ambient Comfort plant at Chakan serving **Mahindra & Mahindra**, peak turnover ~Rs 440 crore, commissioning across Q4 FY27 and Q1 FY28 _(~1.3% of mcap)_.
**The Leela Palaces** - **up to Rs 185.00 crore** of preference capital into 76%-held **Buildminds Real Estate**, which is developing the group's Ayodhya hotel, through FY2028-29 _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Valiant Laboratories** - **up to Rs 60 crore** into wholly-owned Valiant Advanced Sciences via 1% preference shares _(~17.1% of mcap; no capacity or timeline attached)_. **Bharat Forge** Rs 240 crore; **M & B Engineering** Rs 30 crore.

**Stated in capacity, not rupees:** **Pitti Engineering**, **KSH International** (43,445 MT now, 59,045 MT by FY27 exit), **Ambuja**, **Rupa**, **Ind-Swift**, **Amara Raja**, **JSW Energy**, **K.P.R. Mill** and **Mitsu Chem**.
distress_risk: **Insolvency intimations, none quantified:** **Reliance Home Finance**, **SKIL Infrastructure**, **Compuage Infocom**, **DPSC** and **Premier**; **Value Industries** delayed its results, which in an insolvency is itself the disclosure.

**Pending with no amount:** **MTNL**, **Inspirisys**, **Manorama Industries**, **Gammon India** and **Energy Development Company**; **Jagran Prakashan** filed under both insolvency and litigation heads.

**Mis-tagged, and worth saying so:** **IZMO** and **Elpro International**'s delisting-tagged rows are a results intimation and a fixed-price outcome, and **Alok Industries'** buyback-tagged row is a share-dematerialisation window.
equity_allotments: **Committed Cargo Care** - a **past conversion**: 41,09,160 shares at Rs 81 on receipt of the balance **Rs 24.96 crore** at Rs 60.75 a warrant _(~6.2% of mcap)_.
**Bikewo Green Tech** - **new**: 4,52,600 shares and 2,42,35,400 warrants at Rs 31 on **Rs 18.78 crore of upfront 25%**, a ~Rs 75.13 crore issue against a Rs 102.39 crore market cap.

**Hindustan Media Ventures** - **Rs 32.50 crore** on warrant conversion _(~4.5% of mcap)_. **Chatha Foods**, **Suditi Industries**, **Gretex**, **JTL Industries** and **Yatharth Hospital** filed allotments with no amount stated.

**The Phoenix Mills** - its subsidiary **Mindstone Mall Developers** allotted **Rs 99.98 crore pro-rata** to its 51/49 shareholders, Phoenix subscribing Rs 50.99 crore, with **no change in shareholding** _(~0.15% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Embassy Developments** - **up to Rs 362.62 crore** of convertible warrants to the **promoter group**, to repay shareholder debt _(~4.1% of mcap; the largest rupee raise on the tape)_.

**ACI Infocom** - a **~Rs 50.00 crore** issue of shares and warrants at Rs 1.53 against a **Rs 18.67 crore market cap**, alongside an objects change into aviation, MRO and drones; the Mandavias have also opened a **26% offer at Rs 1.53**.
**Precision Wires India** - **37,50,000 convertible debentures at Rs 400, Rs 150.00 crore**, converting within 18 months _(~2.0% of mcap; equity on an 18-month delay)_.

**Kaya** - **18,24,150 shares at Rs 274.10, Rs 50.00 crore**, to Axana Estates and Plutus Investments _(~12.2% of mcap)_. **Om Metallogic** approved a **Rs 22.00 crore** rights issue with ratio and record date undetermined _(~84.0% of mcap)_.
m_and_a: **No stated consideration:** **Piramal Pharma**, **ICICI Prudential AMC**, **KSH International**, **Neptune Petrochemicals** and **Pet Plastics**; **Choice International** Rs 6.22 crore and **GVP Infotech** Rs 0.20 crore are immaterial against their own size.

**Schemes with no swap ratio or consideration quantified:** **Godrej Properties**, **R K Swamy**, **HLE Glascoat**, **Zodiac Clothing**, **GCCL Infrastructure**, **EKI Energy** and **Samvardhana Motherson**.
**Memoranda and business agreements, none valued:** **Texmaco Rail**, **Hardcastle & Waud**, **Ice Make Refrigeration**, **DC Infotech** and **IKIO Technologies**.
order_wins: **Consolidated Construction Consortium** - **Rs 220 crore** of item-rate Buildings & Factories contracts covering 8.00 lakh sq ft, executable before FY2028-29 _(~32.1% of mcap; the annexure names the buyer only as “Various clients”)_.
**RailTel** - **Rs 119.19 crore including tax** from the **Department of Posts** for Postal Life Insurance cloud services, to be delivered by 21-Sep _(~1.29% of mcap)_.
**Fabtech Cleanrooms** - **Rs 152.30 crore of new orders in July**, Pharma Rs 88.42 crore and Renewables Rs 63.00 crore, against a Rs 490.13 crore order book _(~32.1% of mcap; a monthly aggregate)_.
**A-1 Limited** - a **~Rs 38.70 crore plus GST** supply order for acids and industrial chemicals from the **Solar Group of Industries**, running August to October _(~17.1% of mcap)_.

**Om Power Transmission** - a **Rs 24.03 crore** letter of intent from **GETCO** for 5.17 km of 66 kV underground cable _(~4.1% of mcap)_. **Knowledge Marine** took Rs 11.41 crore of Paradip Port patrol-boat hire.
**Siyaram Recycling Industries** - a **Rs 2.64 crore brass-scrap order from Dharma Metalex**, to be executed within seven days _(~3.1% of mcap)_.
**Bharat Electronics** - a **Rs 541 crore** order _(~0.18% of mcap, below the notability bar)_.

**Already published:** **Bajel's** two PGCIL packages ran on 08-Aug - today's release prints the bands as **INR 400 Cr+ and INR 300 Cr+** - and **Jamna Auto's** Rs 47 crore Adityapur facility on 07-Aug.
other_notable: **Rating actions, one notch change:** **Premier Polyfilm** was **revised** on Rs 54 crore; **RattanIndia Power**, **NLC India**, **Refex Industries** and **Nila Infrastructures** state no notch change.
**Shareholding and SAST disclosures** - 48 rows, detail deliberately not carried.
**Governance:** **Precision Wires** - CFO **Mohandas Pai** retires and Deputy CFO **Krina Parekh** is appointed. **CMS Info Systems** appoints **Will Poole** an additional independent director.
